metadata.name: GTA VI-Inspired HUD - Lucia (GTA V Enhanced)
metadata.description:
Lucia, a playable 4th character, for the GTA VI-Inspired HUD on GTA V ENHANCED (GTA5_Enhanced.exe). By FBICat. Fan-made and inspired by GTA VI. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two. The Lucia model is fan-made.
NEEDS the HUD first: GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD-Enhanced.oiv and GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD-RegisterPatch.oiv (2.5.1 or newer), installed to the mods folder. Then install this package the same way.
What it installs - dlcpacks:/luciaped/ Lucia as a 4th character - dlcpacks:/luciaolf/ the GTA Online female wardrobe and hairstyles for her - both added to dlclist.xml, each only if it isn't listed yet (safe to install again) - the packs are converted to the Enhanced (gen9) resource format
Play as Lucia: hold Left Alt (controller: hold D-pad down), press E until her picture is highlighted, then let go.
https://github.com/Geckomacabre/GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD
metadata.licence: Personal use. By FBICat. The Lucia model is fan-made. Contains art cut from Rockstar's official GTA VI media (property of Rockstar Games). The GTA Online wardrobe and hairstyles are Rockstar Games' own assets, repacked for Lucia.
